source.note: Tokens are CSS custom properties on :root in an inline <style>; component CSS below is resolved to light-theme literals because the panel's shadow DOM has no access to that page's :root. Dark values are listed in colorMeta.*.dark.

headline.purpose: Page h1 only; carries a 13px/500 muted small.

title.purpose: h2 section heads, card names, nav brand.

subtitle.purpose: h3: env names, top-level result keys.

minor.purpose: h4, muted: nested result keys, args, examples.

body.purpose: Default text; nav right cluster and card footers drop to 12.5px.

table.purpose: table.data cells and the health strip; .key cells at 500.

stat.purpose: The number in a stat tile, over a 12px muted caption.

pill.purpose: Status pills and the copy button.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Rest shadow on cards, buttons, tables, pre, selected segment, tool details.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Lift on hovered cards and open/targeted tool details.

shadows.name: dot-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft ring around the 8px health-strip dot in its state colour.

shadows.name: nav-glass
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px)
shadows.purpose: The sticky nav's translucency; the only blur in the system.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Every transition: color, background, border-color, box-shadow, text-decoration-color, chevron transform. Default easing (ease).

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Running state on pill dots and the strip dot.

motion.name: copy-feedback
motion.purpose: How long the copy button reads 'copied'.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } *, ::before, ::after { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; } }

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: tighter page padding, 44px nav, nav right cluster wraps to its own row, strip 12.5px, .scroll uncapped.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: max-width of main; nav and strip align their content to it.

theme.mechanism: color-scheme + CSS custom properties; prefers-color-scheme applies unless html[data-theme] is set; button.theme cycles system / light / dark; stored in localStorage 'shed-theme'; boot script sets data-theme before paint.
theme.fontFace: @font-face Inter 100-900, font-display swap, latin unicode-range, src /static/inter.woff2 (self-hosted, SIL OFL, Google Fonts v20 subset).

narrative.northStar: The Status Board Next to the Terminals
narrative.overview:
A one-machine operations dashboard that sits beside dark terminals and must answer "is anything failing?" before it shows anything else. It takes the Linear / Vercel / Raycast product idiom and plays it straight: layered neutral surfaces, hairline borders, soft ambient shadows, a single indigo accent reserved for interaction and selection, and state colour (green, red, amber) only where it carries meaning. No irony, no added quirk, no decoration that does not carry a reading.

Density is the point. Body copy runs at 13.5px Inter with tabular numerals, tables at 13px with 12px muted headers, and the whole page is a stack of hairline-separated, sticky-headed, scannable regions. Elevation is real but quiet: panels sit one pixel-shadow above the ground and lift to a 14px blur on hover. Light and dark follow the Mac setting with a three-way switch; the dark theme is a true near-black, not a dimmed light theme.

The scale is small and fixed: six spacing steps (4 to 32px), radii from 6px (buttons) to 10px (cards), one transition duration (150ms), one animation (a 1.2s opacity pulse on anything running). Everything is served from one stdlib `http.server` page with inline CSS; the system has to stay expressible as a single string.
keyCharacteristics: Health first: a full-width strip under the nav states failing / running / healthy before any content.
Layered neutrals: tinted ground, white or near-black panels, hairline borders, ambient shadows.
One accent (indigo) for interaction, selection and focus; state colours only on pills, dots, strips and notices.
Inter at 13.5px with `cv11` + `ss01` and tabular numerals everywhere a number can change.
Status pills with a leading dot; segmented controls for filters; sticky table headers.
150ms transitions, a single 1.2s pulse, both killed under reduced motion.
Light and dark from the OS, overridable per browser (`shed-theme` in localStorage).

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only on things you can act on or have selected: the primary button, the current tab, the focus ring, the caret, selection. Never on headings, borders at rest, or data.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only State Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber are set on pills, strip dots, `.error` and `.notice` and nowhere else. A number is never coloured; its pill is.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Every colour token has a light and a dark value and both themes share every rule; the dark theme is a different palette under the same CSS, not a filter. A new colour must be added to all three blocks (`:root`, `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, `[data-theme="dark"]`).

rules.name: The 18px Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page is set larger than 18px. Hierarchy comes from weight (600 vs 400 vs 500), colour (ink vs muted) and tracking, not size.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Any element whose number can change between refreshes gets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so it does not shimmy.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two box-shadows, rest and lift, and the only transition between them is hover or open. Buttons drop their shadow entirely on `:active`; nothing ever gets a third, larger shadow.

rules.name: The Border Carries Dark Rule
rules.body: In dark mode shadows go to 50% black but the border steps from `hairline` to `hairline-strong` on hover; the edge, not the glow, is what reads.

dos: Do put the health answer first: any new page keeps the nav and the strip and opens with an `h1` + `.meta` row before content.
Do build new controls from the existing primitives: pill for state, `.seg` for a filter, default button for actions, `.primary` for the one action that runs something.
Do keep tables in `.scroll` > `table.data` with the 12px sticky header and 13px cells; density is a product commitment.
Do use `tabular-nums` on any number that changes, and the `.num` / `.time` / `.key` cell classes.
Do add every new colour to all three theme blocks and check it on `desktop-bdo-dark.png`-style dark captures.
Do stay inside the six-step spacing scale and the 4 / 6 / 8 / 10px radius ladder (999px for pills).
Do keep state colour on the pill, dot, strip or message box, with the hue's wash behind it.
donts: Don't set any text above 18px or use a second typeface; hierarchy is weight and colour.
Don't colour headings, borders at rest, or data cells with the accent or a state hue.
Don't add a third shadow, a hard-offset shadow, a gradient, or an image background; the lift stops at `--shadow-2`.
Don't introduce a motion longer than 150ms or a second animation; the pulse is the only ambient movement and it must stay inside the reduced-motion kill.
Don't use amber for warnings; in this system it reads as "running".
Don't load web fonts or icons from a CDN or icon package; the font is self-hosted and the only icons are inline SVG (house mark, theme circle, masked chevron).
Don't move the stylesheet out of `_STYLE`; the system has to remain one inline string served by stdlib `http.server`.
